name: REAL
description: REAL is a benchmark and framework for evaluating autonomous agents on deterministic simulations of real-world websites. It includes 112 practical tasks across 11 website replicas, testing multi-turn interactions requiring information retrieval and state-changing actions.
reputation: REAL is a very recent benchmark for autonomous web agents and is not yet broadly established, though it targets realistic multi-step website interaction.
notes: Evaluates autonomous agents on realistic web navigation tasks with a novel evaluation framework combining programmatic and LLM-based judgments.
